title: The Discman cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is a Discman on the seawall, headphones coiled, no one. The owner says that's hers. Wood says it's a Discman. The owner says it's hers and she's back and the strip should say so. The strip did, Monday. The owner missed Monday.

panels.composition: The cover: a Discman on a seawall's top, headphones coiled beside it, the bay beyond. No one.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing a portable CD player on a seawall with headphones coiled beside it above a gray bay, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.

balloons.text: It's hers. She's back. Say so.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner holding a small booklet and pointing at its cover, black and white, no words
a young man, dry, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The owner going to the back of the rack for Monday's. Reading it standing up. Wood at the door. She reads the whole week. The strip waits.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner standing by a wire rack reading a small booklet from front to back while a young man waits in the doorway, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'I missed Monday.' The Discman on the wall, no one.
